senses.gloss:
शैव शैव, i. e. शिव + अ,
 I. adj. Relating, belonging, to Śiva, Rām. 1, 66, 19.
 II. m. A worshipper of Śiva.
 III. n. A plant, Vallisneria octandra.
शैवता शैव + ता, f. Worship of Śiva, Rājat. 5, 43.
शैवल and शैवाल शैवा̆ल, see शेवाल.
शैवालक शैवाल + क, A substitute for शैवाल, at the end of a Bhvr. comp., Śṛṅgārat. 1.

शैव्य शैव्य,
 I. i. e. शिव + य, adj. Relating to Śiva.
 II. m.
 1. One of the horses of Kṛṣṇa.
 2. i. e. शिवि + य, A tribe of the Śivis.
 3. A proper name.
 III. f. या, A proper name, Sāv. 6, 2.
